name: Zirgund
source:
Twin sister of Yurgund, and daughter of a wealthy merchant. She also serves as a maid servant to Kiral.

She is a promiscuous beauty who uses her feminine wiles. She is "dating" Kiral, but her true goal is to become queen in the future, and will use her body to achieve that goal.

Her sister, Yurgund serves Tarakin.

[From [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/103kyonyu5/#character]official site[/url]]
